summary: Key synced inventory listing links by VIN and rekey legacy links.
reason: Inventory sync extracts HTML links with URL and slug fields, not a vin field; parse their vehicle URL before using a descriptive name as the storage key, migrate safe old links, resolve inventory learning aliases without changing their metadata, and refresh listing metadata without losing cached full details.
validated_outcome: A normal HTML sync supports local VIN lookup; a v9 store rekeys safe old links while preserving learning rows and resolving exact old inventory IDs to VINs, including list and forget by VIN; it skips ambiguous names and unscoped references, and preserves hydrated vehicle or full detail records; later sync refreshes listing metadata; full Go tests, vet, builds, skill verification, and diff check pass.
